definitions.explanation: Describes buildings or structures of relatively few stories, or the lower layers of something such as the atmosphere or a building.

examples.japanese: {低層|ていそう}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: To live in a low-rise apartment building.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低層|ていそう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This area has many low-rise houses.

examples.japanese: {低層|ていそう}⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日当|ひあ}たり→日当たり：07498_hiatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Offices on lower floors can sometimes have poor sunlight.

notes:
Refers to buildings or structures that are low in height, typically three stories or fewer. Often contrasted with {中層|ちゅうそう} (mid-rise) and ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ (high-rise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低層|ていそう}⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧: low-rise building
- {低層|ていそう}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: low-rise apartment building
- {低層|ていそう}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: low-rise housing
- {低層|ていそう}⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧: lower floors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧: high-rise — the opposite, referring to tall buildings
- {中層|ちゅうそう}: mid-rise — between low-rise and high-rise

USAGE:
In Japanese urban planning, {低層|ていそう}⟦{住居|じゅうきょ}→住居：11612_juukyo⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (exclusively low-rise residential zone) is a common zoning designation that restricts building height.
